Info

Defines CppInterface domain model representing a C++ interface class.

class gen_test.core.model.cpp_interface.CppInterface(name: str, namespace: str = '', includes: tuple[str, ...] = (), methods: tuple[CppMethod, ...] = (), base_classes: tuple[str, ...] = (), header_path: str = '')[source]¶

Bases: object

Domain model representing a parsed C++ interface.

Parameters:

  • name – Name of the interface class/struct.

  • namespace – Namespace of the interface (e.g. “acme::hw” or “”).

  • includes – Sequence of include header directives.

  • methods – Sequence of pure virtual CppMethod objects.

  • base_classes – Sequence of base classes if any.

  • header_path – Original path to the interface header file.

base_classes: tuple[str, ...]¶
property clean_name: str¶

Returns class name without leading ‘I’ if followed by uppercase letter, e.g. ISerialPort -> SerialPort, Reader -> Reader.

property fake_class_name: str¶

Returns Fake class name, e.g. FakeSerialPort.

property full_qualified_name: str¶

Returns fully qualified C++ name including namespace.

header_path: str¶
includes: tuple[str, ...]¶
methods: tuple[CppMethod, ...]¶
property mock_class_name: str¶

Returns GoogleMock class name, e.g. MockSerialPort.

name: str¶
namespace: str¶
property snake_name: str¶

Converts clean name into snake_case, e.g. SerialPort -> serial_port.

property test_class_name: str¶

Returns GoogleTest fixture class name, e.g. SerialPortTest.
